name: OpenCodex
description: Installs OpenCodex (ocx) for Remote Hub clients or runs a standalone proxy and dashboard as an s6-overlay service on Debian/Ubuntu images.

mode.description: `client` installs the CLI and refreshes an existing Remote Hub connection at startup. `standalone` runs a local proxy and dashboard.

version.description: OpenCodex npm version or dist-tag to install, such as `latest`, `preview`, or `2.51.0`.

port.description: Loopback port the standalone OpenCodex proxy and dashboard listen on. Ignored in client mode.

serviceUser.description: User account that owns the installation and runs OpenCodex. `automatic` prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified DNS name that exposes the standalone dashboard through the Caddy Feature. Requires `mode=standalone`.
